**What are you building?**
A short description of your Phoenix app and the problem you want Claude/Cursor to solve.

**Which schemas or tools are you exposing?**
List the Ecto schemas, routes, or custom tools you want an MCP client to use.

**What works today?**
What have you tried? What is already useful?

**What is missing or blocking you?**
Be specific: installation friction, authorization, transport, docs, client compatibility, etc.

**Can we list you in ADOPTERS.md?**
Yes / No / Only anonymized. If yes, add a link and one-line description.
